$comment: Sandbox policy for work scoped to the BigKiji Universe app itself.
Before V2.5 this file did not exist, so SandboxPolicyResolver fell through to its
safe-default: write access to the ENTIRE app directory and all five paid providers
allowed. That default is permissive by accident rather than by decision, so the
Resolution rules that constrain what can usefully be written here:
- roots outside the Vault are dropped by the resolver, so every path is Vault-relative
- paths matching the sensitive-path patterns (.env, .ssh, keys, credentials) are
dropped as well, and that filter is not configurable from this file
- filesystem.denyRead / denyWrite and the network block are read by the pi CLI's
own sandbox package, NOT by this app; do not rely on them here

models.$comment: Paid execution still requires an owner-approved disclosure manifest per run; this list only bounds which providers may ever be offered.

$comment: PiAgent indexes these roots and injects the matching skill's standing rules into
each assignment prompt as TEXT. No filesystem access is granted by this block —
it exists so the roots are declared in one auditable place.
English copies ship with the app and win on an id collision; the owner's Japanese
originals under ~/.claude/skills are the source of truth and are never modified.
